_note: Concept-art shot list for CIPHER: DEAD TURF. Premise per docs/decisions/ADR-003. The crowd are ordinary chipped citizens, NOT zombies: no rot, no blood-soaked horror, no glowing eyes. Their only tell is a small amber implant indicator at the temple or nape. Red eyes are reserved exclusively for the rare engineered things released from the labs. Half these shots are daylight on purpose.
style: cinematic video game concept art, near-future grounded realism set about five years from now, third person action game, believable real-world detail, photographic depth of field, volumetric atmosphere, dense detail, film grain, painted by a senior concept artist, ultra detailed, 8k

shots.title: Midday. They look like anybody.
shots.prompt: Bright overcast midday on an ordinary suburban American street. A dense crowd of several hundred completely normal-looking people advancing steadily toward the viewer between parked cars and clipped lawns: office workers in shirtsleeves, a delivery courier still in uniform, a woman in gym clothes, an old man in a cardigan. Clean clothes, no blood, no wounds, no rot, normal human eyes. Every single one has a tiny amber indicator light glowing at the temple, a field of small amber pinpricks across the whole crowd. Blank, calm, purposeful faces all aimed the same way. Utterly ordinary and deeply wrong

shots.title: The tell
shots.prompt: Tight cinematic portrait of an ordinary middle-aged man in a supermarket polo shirt, harsh daylight, shot from three-quarter angle. A small surgical implant sits just behind his temple under the skin with a single amber status LED glowing through a healed scar. His eyes are completely normal human eyes, calm and unfocused, looking slightly past the camera. No blood, no injury, no horror makeup. The horror is entirely in how ordinary he is

shots.title: The stalled freeway, hard sun
shots.prompt: A multi-lane freeway in harsh bright afternoon sun, jammed solid with thousands of abandoned cars, doors hanging open, heat shimmer and dust haze. A vast crowd of ordinary clothed people picks its way steadily between the vehicles toward the viewer, hundreds deep, tiny amber implant lights visible on temples. A few large white corporate cargo drones still fly a delivery route overhead, oblivious. Dry grass, concrete, sun-bleached colour, no blood

shots.title: Hacked humanoids in the crowd
shots.prompt: Three near-future commercial humanoid service robots walking amid a crowd of ordinary people on a daylight city street. Scuffed white and grey polymer shells, exposed cable runs at the joints, corporate logistics livery, one still gripping a delivery tote. Their heads track the viewer in perfect unison, amber sensor bars lit. Industrial and believable hard-surface robot design, real proportions, the same size as the people around them, harsh natural daylight, dust and debris

shots.title: The logistics network never stopped
shots.prompt: Two large white corporate cargo delivery drones the size of small cars flying low over a ruined daylight city street, heavy lift octocopter design with slung parcel containers and worn brand livery, rotor downwash kicking up dust and litter. One has been crudely modified with a bolted-on weapon mount and armour plate. Below them a crowd of ordinary people moves down the street. Grounded near-future industrial design, overcast daylight

shots.title: Holding the lot in daylight
shots.prompt: A heavily built man in a worn jacket and body armour standing behind a hand-welded scrap metal barricade across the entrance to a chop shop yard, seen over his shoulder in flat overcast daylight. He is firing a light machine gun into an advancing crowd of ordinary clothed civilians thirty metres out. Spent brass in the air, muzzle smoke, sandbags and welded car doors, oil drums. The violence is grounded and awful rather than heroic, real weapon handling, no gore spectacle

shots.title: The only thing with red eyes
shots.prompt: A single engineered creature emerging from a shattered biological containment door in a wrecked laboratory corridor, harsh flickering white strip lighting and emergency red beacons. Wet grey-pink hairless musculature over an elongated distorted human frame, surgical ports and tags still fixed to it, and burning red eyes. Genuinely monstrous and biological. Blood and torn containment plastic. This is the rare exception in a world of ordinary-looking enemies, boss reveal shot

shots.title: Night, sodium, the wave
shots.prompt: Over-the-shoulder third person view behind a heavily built man in a long coat holding a light machine gun on a ruined city street at night, sodium vapour streetlight, wet asphalt reflecting orange, volumetric haze. A large crowd of ordinary clothed people advances toward him, backlit, small amber implant lights at their temples, normal eyes. Muzzle flash, spent casings, burning cars, bodies on the road. Strong rim lighting and heavy silhouettes
